what_happened: The retry of a drain-fix job (a study correction) was rejected at the final verdict. One of 7 acceptance criteria was unmet: running `cargo run -p xtask -- site` must build the study without error and the drain source check must pass on the corrected study. There was one major finding and no blockers. Claim c45 in studies/firstmate-work-handling/claims.json (lines 345-350) was still not checked. Its new sources do not support its main fact, so the row goes back to Queued and the source check may keep reporting it. No checks are listed as failed.
cause: The producer replaced the sources for c45 without anything confirming that the new sources actually back the claim's main fact. The criterion was only checked by the source check at the final verdict. Nothing ran that check on the edited claims during the producer's work. Nothing made the producer confirm that each claim it touched reads as supported by its cited sources, so a retry could swap sources and still leave the claim unsupported. Claim content written or repaired from a partial reading went uncross-checked against the authoritative source until the verifier.
prevention: Run the study's drain source check (the same check the criterion names) automatically after the producer edits claims.json, and feed any claim it still reports back to the producer as a failing item to fix before the job goes to the verifier. The producer must not finish while a claim it touched is reported as unsupported. The gate counts show no disagreements for any gate, so no gate is relaxed or removed.
proposed_request: Fix claim c45 in studies/firstmate-work-handling/claims.json so the study's source check passes. Outcome: `cargo run -p xtask -- site` builds the study without error, and the drain source check reports no problem for c45 or any other claim. Either replace c45's sources with ones that actually support its main fact, or change the claim to what its sources do support, and keep the row from returning to Queued. Before finishing, run the source check and show its output as clean. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry. Do not change files outside the study and its changelog.
